kinnaraWeaponMastery.status: Minimum Master user-confirmed; constrained scheduled draw is the working algorithm realization.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.target: Only the weapon instance granted by the actual Kinnara type result; no guarantee for unrelated main/bonus weapons.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.selection: Before the instrument scheduled mastery draw, intersect ordinary eligible outcomes with rankIndex >= configured Master index. Preserve positive declared weights, then normalize and freeze the surviving odds.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.weights: Use user-specified normal Weapon Mastery rank weights if present, otherwise base weight 1 per eligible rank. Apply the Master-or-higher constraint before normalization; keep one actual scheduled spin.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.emptyPool: Missing configured Master rank, invalid weights, or no eligible positive rank at/above Master is a configuration error. Missing/null uncommitted base weights use 1; do not bypass another guard or silently grant Master.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.scheduledSpin: Perform exactly one actual scheduled mastery spin for the instrument, even if only one result survives at 100%; record and react to the real outcome.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.base: Commit the actual allowed base result. Never roll a low rank then reroll, overwrite it, or add another mastery spin.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.enchantment: The granted instrument is enchantable. After its Master-or-higher result, schedule the ordinary compatible enchantment flow when its slot is available; preserve the normal acquisition/result/reaction and consumed-slot contracts.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.mainWeapon: Keep the main Weapon spin and any authorized bonus acquisitions; None does not remove this owned instrument.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.lateGrant: A later authorized Kinnara component acquisition opens the ordinary pending owned-weapon subflow and returns to its saved caller.
kinnaraWeaponMastery.identity: Alat Musik is a fixed generic weapon grant. Instrument model/profile remains pending; no instrument-choice wheel or sound/music power is added.

powerMasteryModifiers.emptyInventory: No owned power means no mastery spin or phantom power.

masteryStacking.status: Working additive interpretation for distinct authorized modifiers; scale and maximum pending.
masteryStacking.formula: sharedEffectiveRankIndex = sharedRolledRankIndex + sum(distinct active all-owned-power mastery modifiers)
masteryStacking.uniqueness: Each source modifier is active once for the character shared rank. Deduplicate by characterId/modifierDefinitionId/sourceComponentId/sourceSpinId; never multiply by owned power count.
masteryStacking.independence: Distinct authorized all-owned source bonuses add once to the ordinary shared rank. Each power reads that rank unless it has the explicit source-bound God Authority maximum; no modifier creates a power or extra spin.
masteryStacking.base: Keep one immutable character-level rolled base rank. Per-power rolled/effective fields are projections of the shared record, not independent sampled results.
masteryStacking.cap: Raw mastery0..9; final base plus distinct modifiers without numeric floor/cap. Intrinsic ability limits remain separate.
masteryStacking.lateActivation: Project new source bonuses from the same common base without respins; ordinary late grants inherit that rank and explicit God Authority uses base9 plus shared final modifiers.

routing.optionalReferences: Old Barong forms, Naga legacies and guardian/duty proposals are reference candidates with no active caller in this local event plan. They add no hidden spin or bonus.
routing.identity: Barong Bali and Reog Jawa remain distinct. Canonical shared powers do not dispatch Lelembut or Elemental race events.
routing.inheritedOrigins: The same approved profile runs when selected by an authorized Skeleton/Zombie origin or other identity component caller; preserve component provenance, no-repeat family history and saved return.

routing.selectorOrder: Commit the actual local type and its fixed effects/constraints, react, then resolve its single declared Element child if Naga, react to that result, and restore saved continuation.
routing.importedSequence: Actual Imported type -> its approved canonical profile -> commit fixed identity/grants/modifiers and reaction -> only Dragon runs its form/Element children -> exact saved caller.

ownedInventory.duplicatePower: If independent sources grant the same definition, retain each source grant. Consolidation/instance stacking remains a declared catalog policy; never silently lose a grant or duplicate an event on replay.

packageBudget.status: User sets power value 2 stat points, stronger four-point packages and delegates remaining Mythical Beasts around three points. Current remainder uses exactly three.
packageBudget.scope: Mythical Beast package design; preserve all previously defined Local/Dragon/Phoenix effects. No automatic rebalance of other families or existing committed characters.
packageBudget.formula: packagePoints = 2 * declared grantedPowerCount + sum(declared positive numeric stat bonuses)
packageBudget.meaning: Design accounting only. A power worth two points creates no +2 stat modifier. Score is per source package/component, not a character-wide cap or probability rule.
packageBudget.unpriced: Weapons, mastery bonuses, guarantees and event-only benefits have no cost supplied here. Existing Local packages containing them remain unpriced in total; never score an unspecified cost as zero or force them to three.
packageBudget.preserve: Dragon remains one selected Element power plus two numeric points = four; Phoenix two powers = four. Other existing Local packages remain as specified. Strength/power potency/range/cost balance is still separate from package accounting.
packageBudget.odds: Stronger packages do not become rarer from budget alone. Keep equal type weights and all existing explicit probability rules.
